name: GitNexus P-005 engine comparison: aggregate re-derived from the four persisted live arm reports (re-run against the current engine-comparison-cli.ts blob)
summary: Re-ran the engine-comparison CLI aggregate step against the persisted per-arm reports (baseline-lsp-rg, gitnexus-installed, gitnexus-candidate, codebase-memory) under docs/evidence/gitnexus-engine-comparison-2026-10-01. The arm reports were produced by running each engine arm against the real bounded source tree, a real installed GitNexus 1.6.9, a real pinned GitNexus 1.6.12 candidate and the locally built Codebase-Memory binary. This re-run supersedes the 06:30Z aggregate evidence because engine-comparison-cli.ts changed since it (a peer commit added a gitnexusStartLineBase(version) derivation from contracts.ts that REFUSES an unmeasured version), so the earlier live binding pinned a stale cli blob. The aggregate exited 0 and re-derived the committed verdict.json decision `keep` byte for byte (sha256 811a6822c53fbdc097702a5248052939b7c40a126df67f39016bc3b14c7ffb33, unchanged). Per verdict.json the installed GitNexus is kept because Codebase-Memory correct 1/5 < installed 2/5, recall 0.20 < 0.50 and warm median 2.60x installed, and the 1.6.12 candidate is not adopted because correct 1/5 < installed 2/5, recall 0.43 < 0.50, cold index 1.33x and index bytes 1.40x installed. Disclosed limits: the aggregate step itself reads files and does not re-query any engine; GitNexus cold-index wall and RSS are one real /usr/bin/time -v run each taken under shared-host load and are upper bounds; verdict.json records sourceParity.same=false because the installed arm tree fingerprint carries +dirty. NOT byte-stable: the aggregate derives runId and createdAt from today's date, so this re-run rewrote engine-comparison.md, task-runs.json and fairness-audit.json with runId engine-comparison-2026-10-01 -> engine-comparison-2026-10-02, createdAt 2026-10-01T21:23:27.645Z -> 2026-10-02T09:07:34.917Z, the matching rolloutId values and one rewrapped fairness-summary line; verdict.json is byte-identical and no measured number changed.

assertions.evidence: engine-comparison-cli.ts --aggregate --out docs/evidence/gitnexus-engine-comparison-2026-10-01 exited 0 in about 4 seconds (09:07:31Z to 09:07:35Z) with the current cli blob (sha256 39c557fdc183f9bbb3b6019e6216eb922529980a89b5ac9ebfa63813c6deb401).

verdict.json decision is keep with an empty residue list and its sha256 is 811a6822c53fbdc097702a5248052939b7c40a126df67f39016bc3b14c7ffb33 both before and after the re-run (byte-identical), so the derivation is stable against the persisted reports. git diff over the evidence directory shows only engine-comparison.md, fairness-audit.json and task-runs.json changed, and only by the date-derived runId, createdAt and rolloutId fields plus one rewrapped fairness line.

Both reasons in verdict.json cite measured per-arm numbers (correct counts, recall, warm median ratio, cold index ratio, index bytes ratio) taken from the report-*.json files rather than asserted; those report files were not modified by the re-run.

engine-comparison.md records the single cold-index measurement under load and the disclosed bench adapters; verdict.json records sourceParity.same=false for the dirty installed tree; this evidence file additionally discloses that the aggregate output is not byte-stable across calendar days (runId/createdAt/rolloutId are date-derived) while verdict.json is.
